lines.text: Extra practice for the four units of the demo course
This book has more exercises on the four topics of Everyday Grammar: A Demo Course. Each unit
here goes with the unit of the same number in the course, which explains the rules.
Do a unit of drills after the unit of the course, or come back to it a few days later to see what you
remember. The answers are at the back of the book.
Unit 1 To be: am, is, are 2
Unit 4 There is and there are 5

Unit 1 To be: am, is, are
Practice for Unit 1 of the course.
1 My grandparents ___ eighty years old. [is / are]
3 I ___ good at maths. ['m not / isn't / aren't]
6 The windows ___ open, so the room is cold. [is / are]
Practice for Unit 2 of the course.
2.3 Choose the correct form of the verb.
1 My sister ___ to the radio in the car. [listen / listens]
2 We ___ dinner at half past seven. [have / has]
4 The museum ___ at ten in the morning. [open / opens]
5 My parents ___ a lot of tea. [drink / drinks]
6 Bruno ___ his homework after school. [do / does]
Practice for Unit 3 of the course.
1 I would like ___ orange juice. [a / an]
2 There is ___ spider in the bath! [a / an]
4 She studies at ___ university in Spain. [a / an]
5 We need ___ hour to cook it. [a / an]
6 He has ___ old blue car. [a / an]
3.2 Find the mistake in each sentence. Write the correct sentence.
5 We need a onion for the soup.
3.3 Answer the questions. Use a or an and the word in brackets.
Unit 4 There is and there are
Practice for Unit 4 of the course.
4.1 Write sentences with there is or there are.
3 a post office / in the village
1 There are ___ biscuits in the tin. [some / any]
2 Are there ___ buses after midnight? [some / any]
3 There aren't ___ chairs in the hall. [some / any]
4 There are ___ flowers on the table. [some / any]
5 Are there ___ good films on tonight? [some / any]
6 There aren't ___ towels in the bathroom. [some / any]
1 A: Excuse me, ___ a chemist near here?
2 B: Yes, there ___ one next to the bank.
3 A: Great. And ___ any good cafes in this area?
4 B: Yes, there ___ two on Mill Street.
5 A: ___ a cash machine on Mill Street too?
